definition: a creation that came from creative work
description: A cobbled city square at sunset under pink clouds. A young woman with a braid, in khaki cargo trousers and a short jacket, pulls a canvas sheet off a huge sculpture of a whale's head made of welded bicycle chains, gears and scrap metal, and it falls to the ground. She raises both arms in triumph, shouts with joy and then puts her hands to her face, while a fountain jet rises higher behind the whale. A crowd holding coffee cups cheers and claps, ladders and a toolbox stand beside her, and pigeons fly up from the wet cobbles.
